w10_T4_002528: A relief charity began with 203 blankets in its main store and sent 115 of them to a flood shelter. The same collection was then run in 3 towns, each town ending with exactly that many blankets, and all of them were pooled back in the main store. A cold snap took 54 blankets out to the night shelter. A lorry then carried 203 blankets to the coast. How many blankets are left in the main store?
w10_T4_002529: A seed company packs 39 seeds into every sachet. Each box holds 6 sachets, and each carton holds 8 of those boxes. A pallet is stacked with 9 cartons, and half of the warehouse floor is taken up by pallets. Monday's delivery consisted of 4 identical pallets. How many seeds arrived on Monday?
w10_T4_002532: Rafael filled 8 tubs with 206 screws in each tub and tipped them all into one crate. He added 60 loose screws from his workbench, and his apprentice Nina added 12 more, far fewer than Rafael had contributed. Every pallet at the depot carries 4 crates packed exactly like that one, plus 54 spare screws tucked under the wrapping. On Tuesday 7 identical pallets were loaded for the building site. The depot's forklift can lift 900 kilograms. How many screws went to the building site?
w10_T4_002539: A school print room produced 172 booklets on each of the 7 days before term started. The whole pile was then split into 2 equal shares, one for each campus, and the north campus carried its share to its own store room. During the first week the north campus handed out 251 booklets to students. A leaking pipe ruined 100 more, and 5 were damaged in the post. Later 16 booklets came back from a cancelled class. How many booklets are in the north campus store room?
w10_T4_002542: A bike shop opened the month with 217 inner tubes in stock. It fitted 143 of them to customers' bikes during the sale. A cycling club then bought 71 tubes for its tour. The shop threw away 1 more tube that was found punctured inside the box. The shop sits 4 doors down from the station. A delivery van later brought 73 new tubes. How many inner tubes does the shop have now?
w10_T4_002544: A school pond had 26 lily pads floating on it at the start of spring. A cold night killed 9 of them. The gardener added 78 new pads in April and another 36 in May. Slugs destroyed 4 pads in June. Each lily pad still on the pond carries 2 flowers. How many flowers are on the pond?
w10_T4_002545: A pottery had 233 boxes of mugs in its store room and packed 66 more on Monday. A hotel order took 276 boxes away. During the move 16 boxes were crushed and thrown out. The pottery has 3 kilns in the back yard. Every box still in the store holds 6 mugs, and all of those mugs were then shared equally among 6 village shops. The corner shop received one of those shares. How many mugs did the corner shop receive?
w10_T4_002550: On Saturday morning a farm shop had 132 punnets of strawberries in the chiller, and the afternoon delivery brought exactly the same number again, so 2 identical loads sat side by side. During the afternoon 81 punnets were sold at the counter. In the early evening a wedding caterer collected 175 punnets. The shop's car park holds 18 cars. Late that evening a grower dropped off 42 punnets that a market had refused. How many punnets were in the chiller at the end of the day?
w10_T4_002559: Tomas keeps his savings in a jar and counts them in dollars rather than in cents. He started the month with 56 dollars and spent 13 dollars on a book. He then earned 44 dollars helping at his uncle's market stall. A new pair of running shoes cost him 57 dollars. His bus pass costs 9 dollars a month, but the school pays for that. He later gave 22 dollars to his sister. How many dollars are in the jar now?
w10_T4_002566: On Monday morning a wholesaler unloaded 43 pallets, each carrying 6 crates of biscuits. Before lunch 226 of those crates were sent straight out to shops. In the afternoon the crates that were left were opened up, and each crate held 9 boxes, with 6 packets inside every box. Every packet contains 2 biscuits, and the warehouse counts its stock in single biscuits rather than in crates. In the evening a supplier added 64 loose biscuits to the shelf. How many biscuits were on the warehouse shelf that evening?
w10_T4_002568: Early on Monday morning a hostel had 134 clean sheets, and 10 of them were found torn and thrown out. Before lunch the laundry returned 68 more sheets. In the afternoon all the sheets were shared equally among the hostel's 3 floors. On the top floor 28 sheets were used by guests that evening. Every sheet still on the top floor can be folded into 3 pillow covers, and each cover takes 4 clips to hang on the line. How many clips does the top floor need?
w10_T4_002577: A vineyard filled 7 barrels with 205 litres of juice in each barrel. During fermentation 653 litres were lost, and a restaurant bought 376 litres straight from the barrels. The juice that remained was bottled, and every litre filled exactly 2 bottles. The cellar door has been open since 1974. A worker found 3 bottles from that batch on a back shelf and added them to the stack. A merchant then bought 400 bottles. How many bottles are left in the cellar?
w10_T4_002578: On Monday morning Priya had 28 spare exercise books in her cupboard, and she gave 22 of them to a new class. Later that morning the office sent her 70 more books. In the afternoon her colleague Sam borrowed 29 books, though Sam was still left with fewer books than Priya had. That evening 27 books came back from the library, and a parent donated another 14. Every book now in Priya's cupboard has 9 blank pages left in it. How many blank pages are in Priya's cupboard?
w10_T4_002589: Yusuf started the season with 179 tennis balls in the club store. He handed 57 of them to the junior squad. His co-coach Dana took 96 balls for the adult sessions, far more than the juniors had received. During the summer 8 balls were lost over the fence. Each ball still in the store will be used for 6 practice sessions before it is retired, and half of them are already scuffed. How many practice sessions can the store's balls cover?
w10_T4_002592: On Friday morning a garden centre had 182 bags of compost stacked in the yard. A lorry delivered 61 more bags before noon. During the afternoon 140 bags were sold to customers. Every bag still in the yard that evening weighs 8 kilograms. A landscaper then took away 418 kilograms of that compost. How many kilograms of compost were left in the yard?
w10_T4_002595: The cinema had 20 loyalty cards left in the drawer and printed 46 more for the new season. Every one of those cards carries 7 stamps. Each stamp is worth 9 reward points when it is handed in. The manager added 58 extra points to the scheme as an opening bonus. At the kiosk every reward point can be swapped for 2 tokens. How many tokens are all of those points worth?
w10_T4_002598: Nadia had 119 metres of rope in her shed, and her brother Karim brought 29 metres more, a shorter length than Nadia already had. Half of their combined rope was set aside for the climbing wall. From every metre of that set-aside rope the pair cut 8 short skipping ropes. They sold 110 skipping ropes at the summer fete. A primary school bought 205 of them, and a youth club took another 223. How many skipping ropes were left?
w10_T4_002600: Early in the morning a pottery studio had 95 kilograms of clay and used 41 kilograms on a large order. The rest was divided equally between the studio's 2 workrooms, and the east workroom took its share. In the afternoon the east workroom shaped 8 tiles from every kilogram it had. Those tiles were then shared equally among the 3 evening classes. One class packed its tiles equally into 4 boxes. The studio weighs its clay in kilograms rather than in grams. How many tiles went into one of those boxes?
w10_T4_002603: Grace had 230 concert programmes stacked in the foyer, and 15 of them were spoiled by rain. Her colleague Idris printed 60 more, fewer than Grace had stacked to begin with. Every programme in the stack contains 8 pages of advertising. A dozen ushers helped carry the stack inside. A late insert added 57 further advertising pages to the stack in total. How many pages of advertising are in the stack?
w10_T4_002604: On Monday morning Leah had 47 empty jars ready for the honey harvest. By midday her neighbour Tomas had brought her 76 more jars, more than Leah had gathered herself. In the afternoon every jar was filled with 6 ounces of honey and put in the store. That evening a bulk order took 113 ounces out of the store. Late at night another beekeeper delivered 67 ounces to the same store. How many ounces of honey are in the store?
w10_T4_002605: An orchard planted 184 saplings in the first field, added 22 in the second field and another 44 along the lane. Every one of those saplings has grown 7 main branches. Each branch carries 7 smaller shoots. Every shoot has 4 leaves on it. The orchard wall is 300 years old. How many leaves are on the saplings altogether?
w10_T4_002612: On Saturday morning a scout troop had 78 tent pegs in the kit box. They lost 21 pegs on the walk up the hill and bent 14 more while pitching camp. In the afternoon the quartermaster found that each usable peg had 9 spare washers threaded onto it. That evening 8 of those washers rolled into the stream and were lost. A leader then handed over 71 washers from his own kit. How many washers did the troop have?
w10_T4_002616: Miriam counted 228 bricks in the yard, and her cousin Ade added 37 bricks, a smaller pile than Miriam's. A skip delivery brought 30 more bricks, and a demolition down the road provided another 26. Each brick in the yard weighs 7 pounds, and half of them are already stacked on a pallet. What is the total weight, in pounds, of the bricks in the yard?
w10_T4_002620: A library had 94 audiobooks on its old shelf and bought 46 more during the summer. Half of that collection was moved to the new branch across town, and the old shelf kept the other half. A donor then gave the old shelf 36 audiobooks, and a school returned 5 that had been missing for years. A publisher sent 76 review copies to the same shelf. How many audiobooks are on the old shelf now?
w10_T4_002621: On Monday morning a furniture factory ran 3 assembly lines, and each line produced 27 chairs for one batch. In the afternoon 67 chairs came back from a cancelled order and joined that same batch. Fitting each chair in the batch takes 7 screws. The contract covers 3 identical hotels, and every hotel receives a batch of exactly that size. That evening the storeman added 32 spare screws to the shipment. The factory van holds 40 boxes. How many screws are in the shipment?
